GT.raster: Pillow ImageDraw source floating-point coordinates, image-clipped inclusive fill
GT.valid: accepted annotated target pixels only, excluding explicit ignore, under50 boxes, conflicting class/owner, degenerate shapes and one previously visually confirmed class-error shape
GT.unassigned: VOID_UNKNOWN, including pixels outside all boxes
GT.overlap: same owner and class union, conflicting owner or class shared VOID
GT.missing_part: unknown eligibility, excluded from that person-part denominator
GT.annotation_supported_primary: AD4_mIoU4, conditional on annotated target domain
GT.absence_of_negative_GT: OTHER GT support is zero. Precision/IoU exclude spill into unannotated pixels and cannot establish full-frame precision.

route.name: FROZEN_YOLO26X_RGB_ROI_POST_MASK_OWNERSHIP
route.post_mask: clip selected native parsing plane by its frozen YOLO instance mask
route.native_instance_selection: prediction-only designated box IoU >=0.50, highest IoU then score then box geometry then native index
route.compose: after ownership clipping, nonzero native labels overwrite in ascending YOLO confidence; equal scores reverse canonical box geometry so smaller geometry wins; exact equal box geometry retains native detector ID order
route.project: compose all nonzero native labels including Dress/Apparel/OTHER before total label mapping
route.no_detections: valid empty prediction, zero parser calls

person_matching.method: existing CCTV600 detector scorer, descending score then box geometry greedy GT-first matching, highest IoU then GT box geometry
person_matching.identical_geometry: stable source order; ID-renaming invariance guaranteed for distinct box geometries only; identical boxes counted as ambiguous

metrics.global: sum 5x5 integer confusion before ratios; conditional AD4 IoU/precision/recall/F1-Dice per target
metrics.person: each GT person-target with positive valid support is one unit; absent annotation excluded, missed GT contributes zero; divide by derived eligible person-parts per target
metrics.person_domain: all shared valid annotated pixels; wrong owner target pixels contribute FP to the matched prediction
metrics.C3: global mean Hair/Upper/Lower only; Face remains valid non-target
metrics.STRICT_COMPLETE: exact 600 unique packet IDs and all expected ROI packets, no failed/invalid IDs, binding checks and saved-mask scores

timing.sample: reuse the frozen detector 100-image timing membership
timing.clean: no other compute PID and GPU utilization <=5 before load; no other compute PID before/after measured calls
timing.contaminated: retain diagnostics and mark round invalid, no automatic retry
timing.report: ROI adapter latency includes native classes and native internal detector/export where present; instrument learned module calls separately; sum actual ROI calls per image, all-image totals; cached detector timings linked separately; never claim a newly measured end-to-end YOLO+parser run
